games.overview: By day, you run a DVD store in 2012 New York. By night, you’re a ruthless assassin. BLACKWOOD is a cinematic third-person shooter with grounded melee combat, brutal takedowns, responsive gunplay, and a double life to manage.

games.title: Tyr
games.overview: Tyr is a tank shooter where strategy beats twitch reflexes. Pilot heavy-armored vehicles with unique capabilities and upgrade them as you battle for victory with your team.

games.title: Another's Memories
games.overview: Another's Memories is a first-person psychological horror video game located in Argentina. Explore a sinister country house, solve puzzles, and survive ruthless enemies in an immersive experience where every shadow hides a disturbing story.

games.title: Dear Poe
games.overview:
You have received a mysterious email! After the death of an underworld citizen caused by a strange letter, Poe and Arthur are called in to investigate the case and prevent further tragedies. But what appears to be a simple crime soon reveals something much bigger, involving wandering demons and a much more complex dark plot.

Dear Poe is a spin-off of Dark Light, set 6 months before the main events of the game.

games.title: Five More Minutes
games.overview: Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos! Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.

games.title: Deorum
games.overview: Descend into the forsaken dungeon and fight the horrors in the dark. Gather occult materials, craft nightmarish coins, and settle your debt to the cosmic powers. Obey the Divine Festival.

games.title: Sublight
games.overview: Sublight is a survivor-like game set in space. Upgrade, evade, and burn through waves of progressively stronger foes. Unlock new ships and make powerful builds: all to fend off the encroaching fleet.

games.title: How to Fish
games.overview: You and your friends are out drinking and boating. You crash into a small island where you have to fish using everything from fishing rods to assault rifles. Sell your catch, earn money, buy better fishing gear, and defeat boss fishes to unlock new islands and finally make it back home.

games.title: Fallosophy
games.overview: Use just two buttons to climb a colossal pinball table spanning the history of western philosophy. Fallosophy is a minimalist game that turns pinball into a quiet struggle against gravity. No score. No tilts. No savers. Falling down means climbing back up again. Why climb? What does it all mean?

games.title: Diffusion
games.overview: Build defenses to protect your mining sites from the hostile native alien species. Explore the planet and discover the true reasons you've been sent here for. A true old school pixel-art experience.

games.title: Total War: Warhammer III - Lords of the End Times
Torii: Beyond the Gates
games.overview: The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Forge the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why there has been broken links inside the spirit realm. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.

games.title: Fortunato
games.overview: Draw a pair of aces, use them as poker hands or to eliminate your opponents? A poker roguelike battle card game. Build a deck of jokers, defeat bosses, modify cards, and conquer challenges across the ever-changing islands. At the table of four, win by chips or remaining health, your call...

games.title: Stupid Never Dies
games.overview:
Set in a monster-ruled otherworldly dungeon, Stupid Never Dies puts you in control of Davy, a timid zombie living at the very bottom of monster society. Defeat enemies, level up, and collect strange items to grow stronger on your quest to bring Julia, a frozen human girl, back to life.

Steal enemy abilities, customize your undead body with bizarre upgrades, and experience fast-paced combat packed with innovation.

games.title: It's Fine
games.overview: It’s Fine is an active incremental/upgrade clicker game about releasing v1.0 of your game on time.

games.title: Bruisers 2D Boxing
games.overview:
Step into the ring and fight your way to the top in Bruisers 2D Boxing — a gritty, retro-styled boxing RPG where every punch counts and every decision shapes your career.

Welcome to the unforgiving world of professional boxing. Build your legacy from the ground up — train hard, fight smart, and manage the life of an up-and-coming fighter chasing glory. With in-depth 2D boxing action and a rich career mode, Bruisers 2D Boxing captures the raw intensity of the sport like never before.

games.title: Dreadnought Tartarus
games.overview: Dreadnought Tartarus is a semi-automated strategic simulation game centered around a single, colossal battleship. Take control of the massive warship Tartarus and destroy everything in your path as the battlefield continuously advances！

games.title: Of the Devil: Episode 3
games.overview: Morgan finds herself centerstage as the State conducts a witch trial to exorcise itself of one of its most outspoken critics, but she refuses to play the fool in the oncoming torrent of political theater.

games.title: Wrongly Accused
games.overview: Explore historical locations, find and analyse evidence. Unmask the real perpetrator so that justice can be served and the Wrongly Accused can be found innocent. Use problem solving, deduction and critical thinking skills to uncover the truth and maybe even expose a conspiracy in your own time.

games.title: Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional
games.overview: The family computer is infected again and it’s your job to fend off waves of viruses and adware foes with an arsenal of nostalgic Y2K-inspired weapons. Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional is a survivor-like auto-shooter filled with nods to the days when computers were actually fun.

games.title: Moorestech
games.overview: Factory automation meets anime-style RPG. Harness gears and shafts to power machines and conveyors, building an automated factory. Produce items and research tech, evolving from windmills to fusion as you trace humanity’s tech evolution, then launch a rocket home to uncover the truth of your exile.

games.title: Nightwater
games.overview: Forage, craft and automate to grow your factory, unlock new technologies and expand your island to discover new biomes. Progress through the ages from sticks and stones to the Bronze Age, the Industrial Era and into the future to uncover the secret of the Lighthouse and escape this reality.

games.title: Myth of Valderit
games.overview:
Myth of Valderit is a psychological horror experience set in the cursed village of Valderit, inspired by the abandoned Catalan village of La Mussara. You wake up as Nil, separated from your friends Julia and Enric, and soon uncover the dark secrets lurking within the village…

This single-player, first-person experience combines exploration, survival, and puzzle-solving. Nil must endure and remain alive, evading the fanatical devotees of an unimaginable entity.

games.title: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog
games.overview: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

games.title: AGX GP
games.overview: AGX is a heart thumpingly fast, Anti-Gravity racing game. It's lightning‑fast action and Xtreme ability‑based gameplay, will push your reactions and skills to the limit! Welcome To AGX!

games.title: InterViolence
games.overview: Wander through a secret lair. Help a young supervillain move out of his lifelong home. Think about your past, and his uncertain future. The third entry in the Violence series.

items.title: MalViolence: Definitive Edition
items.overview: Caution: Escape from this supervillain at your own risk...A sci-fi visual novel packed with brain-teasing puzzles.

items.title: ProtoViolence
items.overview:
Can a scientist save a test subject from her life’s work?

All documents enclosed relate to ██. ██████ and █████████’s history within the Youth Training and Development Initiative (YTDI)’s child cybernetics and processing program. Unauthorized release of any information constitutes an unacceptable risk to stop’s reputation and will result in immediate termination and potential incarceration.

These documents were recovered from Stop backup servers from previously corrupted data. They pertain to the incident that occurred at YTDI Facility #001 on Oct. 1st, 207█, and record the events from ██. ██████'s first arrival at the facility to the date of the incident.

games.title: Vapor Strange
games.overview: Explore bizarre procedural generated psychedelic worlds, encounter surreal creatures, experience shifting rulesets, retro aesthetics, and altered music for a wild and truly strange experience.

games.title: Hellcard II
games.overview: Hellcard II is a cooperative roguelike deckbuilder that can be played solo or with a team of up to four players. The game takes place in the paper dungeons known from Hellcard and Book of Demons, expanding into new biomes and storylines.

items.title: Hellcard
items.overview: Hellcard is a cooperative roguelike deckbuilder with Singleplayer and Multiplayer modes. Descend into the paper dungeons on your own, recruit computer-controlled companions or join other gamers in fast-paced tactical card battles against the armies of darkness and the Archdemon himself!

games.title: Roadhouse Simulator
games.overview:
Roadhouse is the prelude to Gas Station Simulator where you take on the role of the uncle and explore his humble beginnings. Start as a bouncer at a roadhouse on Route 66 and work your way up to running the entire business.

In this 1st person view simulator game you deal with a multitude of customers and various biker gangs, manage the roadhouse, tend to the bar, master the grill, stock the right supplies and acquire more territories to widen your influence.

games.title: Essentia: A Monster Catching Adventure
games.overview: Isometric dungeon crawler with procedurally generated levels. A wide variety of cute monster characters to collect. A turn-based battle system with unique mana mechanic. Uncover the secrets of the calamity that has left this world in chaos.

games.title: Beyond The Cupola: ISS Simulator
games.overview: You are the ISS crew, where the station's fate depends on everyone. Oxygen leaks, system failures, meteorite threats — repair with your own hands and make real-time decisions. Complete missions, perform spacewalks. Experience life in orbit: in space, nothing goes according to plan.

games.title: Reel Tiny
games.overview: Welcome to Critters Crick! Catch fish, upgrade gear, and explore the mountain’s creek in this loveable micro-fishing game! You play as The Shrew, a mammal with a burning passion for fishing. Bask in the variety of rods, lures, reels, and fish that keep folks in this cozy community busy year-round!

games.title: Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush
games.overview: An alluring oiran dances through the blood-soaked nights of Edo. Where beauty and violence collide — a dopamine-fueled survival action.

games.title: Dream Delirio's
games.overview: Blast through waves of children’s nightmares with Magnus, a cereal mascot fighting to free the children from their fears. Weaponize your breakfast, build game-breaking card synergies and show these nightmares that crunch time is over.

games.title: Last Spaceship
games.overview: Last Spaceship is an adventure puzzle game. Play as a maintenance robot, repair the ship by solving a series of fascinating puzzles, explore its various compartments, and collect relics of human legacy. Experience a story about war, extinction, salvation, and choice.

games.title: Shadow Dungeon
games.overview: Nightmarish monsters crawl forth from the darkness, while the Demon Lord lurks beneath the abyss. Venture into the Shadow Dungeon, carve your way through blood and chaos, and forge your own legendary epic.

games.title: Author Sim
games.overview: Have you ever dreamed of becoming a world-renowned author? Now's your chance! Study masterpieces from other authors, craft breathtaking stories, and maintain a public profile in pursuit of your dream.

games.title: Chinese Strange Stories
games.overview: Step into a living Chinese painting that blends the mystical, supernatural, and the struggles of daily life in the final years of the Ming dynasty. Experience a unique mix of classic turn-based RPG mechanics and dynamic card battling, where strategy and fate intertwine.

games.title: Island Restoration
games.overview: Bring procedurally generated islands back to life. Explore different biomes and damage scenarios. Relax as you clean, upgrade your tools, rescue wildlife, and watch each island return to its natural beauty. Customize your ship and decorate your own private island.

games.title: Beware of the Cartographer!
games.overview:
A young cartographer is sent out by his hierarchy into the rural land of his childhood to redraw a frontier: he will gradually discover that this place, which for him was just a set of inky territories, is actually steeped in stories, inhabited by people who have no idea what's going on around them and whose relationship to space is radically different...
The player embodies a land surveyor who explores a rural territory and must make choices that will have an impact on diplomacy, but also on the local population. The game combines visual novel phases and observational puzzles — the two aspects nourishing each other to modify the plot of an interactive story.

games.title: Silberheim Evolving Card Game
games.overview: Silberheim ECG (Evolving Card Game) is a fantasy trading card game. Cards—called Fragments—can evolve based on a player’s actions and playstyle, creating a personalized experience within the expanding world and lore of Silberheim.

games.title: Fame or Folly
games.overview: In a world where wars are fought on stages, compete for a single royal request from the King. Fame or Folly is a deckbuilder of deckbuilders where you draft a new trouper every turn. Recruit wisely, unlock powerful synergies, and survive the critics in this handcrafted pixel-art strategy roguelite

games.title: IGTAP: An Incremental Game That's Also a Platformer
games.overview: Amass an army of clones to follow your tightly-optimised path. Generate massive amounts of power to upgrade your production and movement abilities.

games.title: Gridlords
games.overview: Gridlords is a strategic async-PvP autobattler set in a fantasy pixel-art world. Build your ultimate castle, command legendary heroes, and outsmart rivals to prove your strategy reigns supreme.

games.title: Patlabor the Case Files
games.overview: Relive iconic scenes from "Mobile Police Patlabor" in this 3D console action game. Experience dual perspectives: Main Missions as the SV2, and Another Side Missions as their rivals. Hone your pilot skills in Simulator Mode, featuring shooting ranges and Labor duels.

games.title: Salvation Denied
games.overview: Salvation Denied is a chaotic co-op building sim for 1–4 players where a crew of small, yellow, mischievous construction robots attempts to build massive structures with heavy machinery and absurd tools. Physics rules everything. Every block has weight, every mistake shifts the balance, and disasters will push your creation to its absolute limit.

games.title: Bluey's Happy Snaps
games.overview:
Explore Bluey’s world like never before in Bluey's Happy Snaps!

Join Bluey and her family in a new photo-powered adventure game. Discover familiar locations, play with loads of toys, and use Bluey's camera to capture and keep all your favorite moments.

items.title: Bluey: Let's Play!
items.overview: Explore, imagine, create & play in Bluey's house. There's so much to do! Wackadoo! Come join Bluey, her friends & family!

items.title: Bluey: The Videogame
items.overview:
Join the fun with Bluey and her family in Bluey: The Videogame! Play a brand-new story set across 4 interactive adventures. For the first time ever, explore iconic locations such as the Heeler House, Playgrounds, Creek and a bonus beach location. Play your favourite games from the TV show, including Keepy Uppy, Chattermax Chase, and more!

The fun doesn't stop there! This game won't be trifficult, just a lot of fun. Experience the joy and wonder of Bluey's world, with local multiplayer you can play with friends and family in story mode and free play! Explore and collect items for your sticker book, unlock outfits and uncover the many secrets and hidden references throughout each location. Recreate iconic scenes or create your very own Bluey inspired adventures and games in Bluey: The Videogame.

items.title: Bluey's Quest for the Gold Pen
items.overview: Join Bluey on a fun-filled quest for the Gold Pen in an original story by Bluey creator, Joe Brumm. A joyful experience for the whole family.

games.title: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer
games.overview: You are the magistrate, and Lucifer stands trial as the defendant. Judge the fallen angel in this dark romance visual novel. Decide whether he is worthy of salvation, or doomed to destruction.

items.title: Obey Me!: One Master to Rule Them All
items.overview:
"Obey Me! One Master to Rule Them All" is a romance simulation and RPG card mobile game produced by NTT Solmare Corp. It is one of many dating simulation games from a dating sim brand called Shall We Date?

Users can experience a story filled with a variety of characters. There is a phone and messaging system as well as entertaining card battles involved. Get through a series of tasks and choose how you wish to enjoy your life in the Devildom!

items.title: Obey Me! Nightbringer
items.overview: An otome game where you raise seven ikemen demon brothers to YOUR liking. Enjoy your life in the Devildom with Obey Me! Nightbringer!

games.title: Tomato Dealer
games.overview: An illegal shop keeping game. Grow tomatoes, dry and sell to customers. Broaden your customer network but be careful, there are undercover cops! Deal with police attention with the help of the mafia.

games.title: Please Fix the Mess
games.overview: Clean up chaotic interiors, remove trash, repaint walls, and redecorate messy spaces, sometimes with a few suspiciously bodies lying around.

games.title: The Canon of Balls
games.overview: Hardcore, first-person, co-op platformer. Shadow of the Colossus' PSX aesthetics meets Monkey Ball. An easy-to-learn, hard-to-master open-world experience to explore and master together with your friends. A vast open world, with each platforming course bringing its own twist.

games.title: Click & Mine
games.overview: Click & Mine is a relaxing incremental mining game. Mine various resources and use them to buy upgrades, allowing you to descend deeper and deeper while unlocking new biomes, ores and skills.

games.title: Sadko
games.overview: Monsters are closing in from all sides, and all you've got is a gusli… and the letter O? Dynamic combat with Slavic folk music, hero progression, and building a unique build to take on each location and its boss - so you can finally face Koschei himself.

games.title: Police Chief Simulator
games.overview: Welcome to Winston Springs, Officer! The local police station is in urgent need of a Chief of Police, and you’ve been chosen for the job! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

games.title: Worlds Explorers
games.overview: Explore alien planets with carefully designed ecosystems, weather, resources, dangers and unique phenomena. Hunt animals for food and collect resources to craft equipment and repair devices on your ship. Escape each unique planet and unlock crew members and new ships.

games.title: Mayfly
games.overview: Mayfly is a story-rich, quiet horror set aboard a narrowboat in Northern England. A short psychological horror experience focused on exploration, story and atmosphere. Search a detailed, highly explorable narrowboat setting that evolves as the mystery unfolds. Uncover clues and memories amidst unsettling shifts in the environment around you. Solve puzzles to guide Caroline on her journey to be reunited with her husband Robert.

games.title: Dog in the Machine
games.overview: A tactical roguelite where you help an AutoDog escape a dystopian mecha-city and get back to their exiled humans. Teach the dog custom tricks to tackle strategic challenges through devastating chain reactions. Break the Machine in your path to freedom!

games.title: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
games.overview: A city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make unusual decisions by stamping decrees, trying at all costs to keep everything from collapsing.

games.title: Driving Test Simulator
games.overview: Test your driving skills by completing challenging driving tests and precise, skill-based scenarios. Offers various scenarios and environments.

games.title: Airport Control 27
games.overview: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.

games.title: How Asian Parents went to School
games.overview: An online 1-4 player co-op adventure where you experience the legendary struggle of getting to school as an Asian parent. Fight a psychopathic bear, defy physics, and survive the emotional damage from Tablo Escobar : an NPC who roasts you every time you fail.

games.title: T.W.I.R.L.
games.overview: It's 3am in your childhood home. Everyone's asleep, but you. Sneak out of your room to do what you always do - "T.W.I.R.L." - whatever that means.

games.title: Charming Hill
games.overview: Charming Hill is a small experimental game where creating beautiful paintings feels easy and natural. No artistic skills are needed; it’s a space to relax, paint, and discover a heartwarming story, or better yet, paint your own.

games.title: Exorcist Hotline
games.overview: The world is full of ghosts. So who you gonna call? The Exorcist Hotline! A multiplayer investigative survival horror puzzle game for up to 4 players. One operator. Three exorcists. And a demon. Work together or die trying.

games.title: Furyball: Rogue Revenge
games.overview: Furyball is a fast paced action roguelite where your only weapon is a bouncing bullet ball. Control the chaos, shatter enemies, and survive sport themed arenas inspired by pinball and grindhouse cinema.

games.title: Keysaster
games.overview: On your way to meet a friend at a cafe, you suddenly black out for reasons unknown.... awakening in a place that is clearly not the human world. If you want to survive, evade hostile entities and search for key items to escape.

games.title: Finding Polka
games.overview: Set off on a playful search to track down the wandering pup Polka in this game of exploration and serendipity. Meet charming characters, lend them a hand to make new friends, and explore a cozy world sketched in ballpoint pen. You don't need words on this adventure, just smiles and high-fives!

games.title: Orbit to Riches
games.overview: Orbit to Riches is a short, relaxing incremental space game where you mine asteroids, upgrade ships, and grow stronger over multiple runs - no timers, no rush.

games.title: Farming Incremental But With Guns
games.overview: Plant crops and shoot them down with your trusty gun. Earn money, purchase upgrades, and cultivate your farm. Watch your crops physically evolve to gigantic proportions. GROW them. Never stop growing them until their shadows block out the sun forever.

games.title: ProTax 98
games.overview: A short 90s bureaucratic horror game where you process impossible tax forms for the living, the dead, and the unborn.

games.title: Required Synergy Workshop: Deja Damnation
games.overview:
Mandatory orientation at a corporate hellscape. The loop never ends. A psychological horror visual novel where your accumulated choices build a hidden profile and the world around you adjusts accordingly.

Public demo available on Steam. Full release is currently in development.

games.title: The Comeback King
games.overview: The Comeback King is a light-hearted, mildly satirical retro boxing management game set in the UK in the 1980s. Take on a has-been boxer and manage his career. Decide who he'll fight, train him up and send him into the ring! Can you guide your boxer to a title contest against the division Champion?

games.title: Plobania 47/B
games.overview: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

games.title: Alpha Spectrum
games.overview: Alpha Spectrum is a cyberpunk RPG set in a dystopian 2030, where a massive cyberattack pushes humanity into systemic collapse. You are a CIA agent with psionic abilities caught in the chaos. Shape an immersive storyline through choices guided by your playstyle and intuition.

games.title: The Call Button
games.overview: It's a psychologial observation-based horror thriller. Every day you wake up in a hospital bedroom. You notice anomalies? Take your pills. You think it's safe? Use the call button. But survive long enough, and you must face your interactive nightmares...

games.title: Scapewatch
games.overview: 28 skills. Three combat styles. Clans, raids, hiscores, pets, capes. Set up your queue, close the tab, come back richer. Scapewatch is the idle MMO for people who actually like the grind.

games.title: Company is Watching
games.overview:
Dear new employee, we are thrilled to welcome you to our production line. Here, your mission is simple, repetitive, and essential: maintain our quotas. Let yourself be lulled by the routine. Obey the instructions. Screw, clean, and destroy what you are told to destroy.

Optimization is our priority.

games.title: Broadside Bets
games.overview: This isn't a casino. This is war! Command the crew, upgrade your deck and collect rule-bending Booty. Discover devastating combinations and destroy your enemies as you navigate a branching map full of encounters, islands and treasure.

games.title: Stellar Breach
games.overview: Blast through massive waves and tough bosses in this chaotic sci-fi roguelite shooter. Guide the charming duo, Barnaby and C.A.T., through a branching narrative via multiple-choice interactions where your story decisions directly alter randomized loadouts and abilities on every run!

games.title: Play Faster
games.overview: Play Faster is a precision platformer built for fast movement, instant retries, and endlessly replayable runs. Master movement, optimize routes, and climb online leaderboards with built-in speedrunning tools.

games.title: Junkyard Stories: Rebirth
games.overview: A dystopian sci-fi adventure where you're a broken robot carrying the consciousness of a legendary hacker. Cross landscapes shaped by war, scavenge supplies, hack systems and solve puzzles as your battery drains. Infiltrate Block-07 to find the person who can save your mind before it's lost forever.

games.title: A Game About Creating The Universe
games.overview: An idler game where you get to build up the universe from scratch. You are a part of an advanced space civilization that builds universes.

games.title: Soulstation
games.overview:
A visual novel between fear and love. Follow Kin as it falls deeper into a rusty world that will one day eat it whole. Will you get on board?

An atmospheric audio-visual narrative of a child who boards a train to the afterlife.

Will you give in to reality? Or crawl your way out? In this beautiful dusk, you need only open your heart.

games.title: Crewed
games.overview: Crewed is a 2–6 player cooperative spaceship management game. Players take on the role of corporate workers operating a fragile, poorly maintained spaceship for a megacorporation. The objective is to keep critical ship systems running, repair dynamic disasters, and complete procedurally generated missions while coordinating with the crew.

games.title: Wheel Make It
games.overview: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

games.title: Craving Wisps
games.overview: Slide in the walls, possess your enemies, and discover a mysterious world threatened by wicked spirits! This short adventure, full of action and humour, will please platformer fans and players looking for an original experience!

games.title: Pegfinity
games.overview: One shot can trigger a massive chain reaction. Launch, bounce, and break the board in this physics-based incremental. Upgrade your build, stack combos, and push every run further into chaos.

games.title: Catnip Cosmos
games.overview:
A short incremental shooter.
Shoot. Upgrade. Incrementally progress further. Pilot cat-operated spaceships on timed Zoomies runs in this space shooter. Combine pilots for powerful synergies, defeat boss challenges to unlock new weapons and improve exponentially.

games.title: Please, Spin
games.overview: The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast!

games.title: For The Cat! Sorcerer's Revenge
games.overview: They killed your cat. Fatal mistake. In this magic-infused bullet-heaven roguelike, develop your wizard, upgrade and evolve spells, collect items, and create unstoppable builds while battling hordes of enemies.

games.title: Scratch the Ticket
games.overview: Scratch the Ticket is a first‑person incremental gambling sim where every ticket is a test of nerves. Print tickets, scratch cells, and decide: cash out now or risk it all. The outcome depends only on your choice.

games.title: Thieves and Gold
games.overview: Smash containers, grab the gold, uncover hidden keys, and recruit a crew of thieves in this medieval loot-heist incremental. Race the clock in Heist Mode or play relaxed in Casual Mode.

games.title: The Birdsong Tree
games.overview: A cozy building and light simulation game where you observe birds, create custom birdhouses, and help a living urban tree grow. Balance sound, diversity, and neighbor reactions as you shape a calm, reactive environment.

games.title: Defrag Incremental
games.overview: A retro incremental where you optimize messy disks, choose the right algorithm, manage heat and wear, make a living from each job, and reboot for permanent BIOS upgrades.

games.title: Mobius
games.overview: If space has no end, where is the exit? Mobius is a gravity-flipping puzzle-platformer set in a looping realm. Cross screen edges to invert gravity and find hidden paths in symmetrical spaces. Solve physical puzzles to reach the mysterious door—what secrets await on the other side?

games.title: Card Homestead
games.overview: Card Homestead is a roguelike deckbuilder where card placement decides everything. Each day, draft one of three delivered cards and stack them onto your plot, engineering powerful chain reactions. Produce gold with efficient synergies and layouts to survive the ever-rising taxes.

games.title: OneStarHotel
games.overview: Run a chaotic one-star hotel with your friends. Cook meals, serve guests, manage the restaurant, and survive the night while hiding the hotel's darkest secret

games.title: Colorfall
games.overview: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op match-3 game where you and your friends each control only 1 color. Survive the falling grid by pulling and throwing orbs to trigger chains and finish tasks before time runs out. If your color piles up, it’s on you to clear the path.

games.title: Growing My Manhole
games.overview: Consume the universe, grow from Manhole to Black Hole in this insatiable incremental game.

games.title: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Bloodmoon
games.overview: A cautionary tale, or a story better left untold? Legacy of the Bloodmoon is the darkest expansion to date for Vampire Survivors. Discover the path to ruin that this pack of villains is headed down. Unlock new weapons and characters to find new ways to snowball against relentless hordes of enemies.

games.title: Chef's Dogma
games.overview: Chef’s Dogma is a roguelite turn-based battler where you journey through the 7-layers of bean dip hell. Upgrade your team through stats, items, or ‘entree’s creating even stronger foods. Experience a multitude of play-styles, Enemies, and locations to help the chef ascend into purgatory…

games.title: Dearbnb
games.overview:
Dearbnb is a cozy management game where you build a real estate empire one room at a time.

Start your journey by renting a small apartment in a modest neighborhood. Carefully decorate rooms, place furniture freely, set prices, and welcome tenants and customers. As you gain experience and reputation, unlock new zones — from poor districts to luxury neighborhoods and expand into residences, shops, and massive commercial properties.

Every room matters.
Every decision shapes your path to becoming a true property tycoon.

games.title: Hellsino
games.overview: Multiply your way out of debt in a roguelike deckbuilder where poker meets grid tactics. Place cards onto a 5x3 board to trigger vertical and horizontal combos. Master the Nexus Multiplier, outsmart a rigged house, and stack massive scores to save your soul from absolute bankruptcy.

games.title: Onigashima: Awakening
games.overview: A predictive deck-building RPG! Build your strategy from over 300 cards! Form powerful formations with unique animal companions! Master countless combinations and claim overwhelming victories! Your adventure to defeat the ONI begins now!

games.title: Stinker Golf
games.overview: An online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you edit the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world.

games.title: Blackout
games.overview: Normal. Or Paranormal. A job sorting through ghost photos. Five days to finish. But it won't end there. Mysterious visitors. A fear that bleeds into reality. And—— Can you escape this curse?

games.title: Demersus
games.overview:
Demersus is a first-person walking sim and psychological thriller experience that explores the horrific reality of alcohol addiction and how that influences the people around you, through environmental storytelling and immersive atmosphere. Navigate the protagonist's fractured psyche, rendered as a beautifully haunting, hand-crafted clay mindscape.

Created for the ZTGK game dev contest by a two-person indie team.

games.title: Meow Box City
games.overview: Meow Box City is a multiplayer, strategy-focused game where, ahead of the upcoming local elections, you build your own lobby against rival parties, thwart your opponents’ plans with devious schemes, and try to boost your popularity in the city by making the right moves at the right time. Collect cards, place your buildings, balance satisfaction–population–revenue… and secure the ballot boxes on election night. Let’s keep this between us: we’re winning...

games.title: Next Reign: Kingdom
games.overview: Medieval incremental kingdom builder combining city building, resource management, automation and auto-battler combat.

games.title: False Alarm
games.overview: False Alarm is a 2D stealth adventure where you enter each level with nothing, and use whatever you can find to complete your mission. Throw a crowbar, blow up a microwave, brew some coffee, drop a chandelier on someone's head. Stay out of the light and distract your enemies however you can.

games.title: Loot Goblins
games.overview: Crack open chests, chain buffs, upgrade and recruit the ultimate goblin crew. Send them deeper into dungeons. Get better loot. Repeat!

games.title: Seeding The Wasteland
games.overview:
Feeling like doing some gardening? Head to the planet Tau to relax with this narrative-driven plant management game!

You'll play as a small robot named Orchid, tasked with cultivating various plants to bring the planet back to life!

You'll have your ship, charging stations, and your trusty tools at your disposal. Aboard the Internode, your shuttle, you'll navigate across a desolate land to reach Demeter, a mysterious robotic entity.

games.title: Fairy Springs
games.overview: You are a magical Fairy tasked with your first assignment: aid the critters of the glen through the seasons of a year. Take your time getting to know the valley's inhabitants in this cozy little adventure. Every day has a new task to complete with each animal neighbor having something fresh to say.

games.title: Hariti
games.overview: "Hariti" is a first-person psychological horror game. You will play as a mother searching for her missing daughter in a crisis-ridden hospital. Experience an atmosphere of extreme dread within the halls of this abandoned Chinese-style medical facility.

games.title: Hack 42: Typing Incremental
games.overview: Hack 42 is a short typing incremental game about crafting powerful hacks and smashing computers for fun and profit.

games.title: Salvation: Echoes of War
games.overview: Explore a haunting purgatory in this third-person stealth adventure. Injured and trapped in a nightmare after war, solve puzzles, outsmart enemies, and rely on your loyal companion to find a way back to life. Can you escape your past and survive the echoes of war?

games.title: Card City Nights Forever
games.overview: It's cards! It's a city! It's night! And this time it's forever! Card City Nights Forever is the third and final installment of the series, with the best core TCG gameplay yet, a whole new huge 3D adventure, and an online mode that will last forever!

games.title: Lisia
games.overview: Drive your truck on deadly roads. Use the winch, build bridges, and spray-paint the body. Reach the summit alone or in co-op with friends. And remember the main rule: don't look down!

games.title: Susanoo
games.overview: A soulslike-typing game where you defeat enemies through typing and parry their attacks with precise timing.

games.title: BloodJack
games.overview: BloodJack, a 2-4 player PvP blackjack battler where every player hides card, manipulates opponents, uses rule-breaking items, and bets the blood keeping them alive as the stakes rise.

games.title: The House in the Hollow
games.overview: With stunning graphics, inspired by the 1920's Art Deco period, and a chilling soundtrack, the "House In The Hollow" will take you on a journey like no other. A journey filled with mystery, horror, and magic, where you are the master of your own fate.

games.title: Forever Ago
games.overview: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you'll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting people, and even make some new friends.

games.title: Calx
games.overview: Calx is an atmospheric 3D action adventure inspired by visionary sci-fi art. Explore planet Syro - vast landscapes filled with crystal structures and ancient technology. Find out what the WARP did to the Quoths civilization. The environment guides you, revealing secrets through exploration.

games.title: Tenebris Somnia
games.overview:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.

games.title: Timeless Rain
games.overview: Explore this foreign world and use manipulate time to defeat any creature who dares to stand between you and your goal! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

games.title: Mystic Land: The search for Maphaldo
games.overview: An old-school RPG game inspired by Wizardry 7, Might and Magic and Eye of the Beholder series. 2d grid-based movement, strategic turn-based combat and lots of places to visit and puzzles to solve.

games.title: Death Rabbit
games.overview: The city that never sleeps has taken a sinister turn, and the dark tunnels of the MTA have become the epicenter of a horrifying outbreak. As Alisa, you must navigate through a labyrinthine underground world fraught with danger, where unspeakable horrors lurk around every corner.

games.title: Paperhead
games.overview:
PAPERHEAD is a fast-paced FPS game set in a world where everything is made out of cardboard and paper but is infested with horror!
Use a pencil as a weapon and explore what exactly went wrong in the secret research facility and why suddenly papercut people were able to...bleed.
Paperhead's Main Features

- Cardboard cute style with a horror twist. Cute but horrifying!

- Brutal and fast-paced combat. Slide to throw enemies in the air, kick explosive barrels into them (or enemies themselves!), and jump onto them Mario-style.

- Use a Pencil as a weapon. Draw a bomb to explode enemies!

- Use a Pencil as a reality-warping puzzle-solving tool. Not sure how to get through? Try to draw a door on the wall!

WHY WOULD PAPER...BLEED?

games.title: Don't Fret
games.overview: Don't! Fret is stylized first-person psychological mascot-horror game set in a musically themed world. Play as a guitar named Fret to solve puzzles, escape from foes, and uncover the mystery behind Harmonic Heights.

games.title: Echo Weaver
games.overview: A fast-paced metroidBRAINia that tells the tale of a ruined society trapped in a fatal time loop. Uncover their story - and your own - as you explore what remains. Use each loop to chip away at the mystery, unlocking powerful knowledge to reshape the timeline and master the loop.

games.title: True Love For Her
games.overview: True Love For Her (TLFH) is a Yandere game inspired by Yandere Simulator and Life Is Strange that doesn’t compete with the original games. This game involves murder and other methods of killing, so it is not suitable for kids. We are not responsible for any actions taken by kids replicating activities from TLFH in real life.

games.title: Gears of War: E-Day
games.overview:
Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​
Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​
Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

items.title: Gears of War
items.overview:
A third-person tactical shooter from Epic, running on the Unreal Engine 3. Gears of War thrusts gamers into a deep and harrowing story of humankind's epic battle for survival against the Locust Horde, a nightmarish race of creatures that surface from the bowels of the planet.

Unlike other shooters, Gears of War is all about teamwork in a big way. All game modes, levels and scenarios are designed specifically to encourage co-operative play, whether it be with A.I. partners or human players (with A.I. teammates designed with specific strengths, weaknesses and personalities.) On top of that, voice recognition will be available for players, and obviously voice chat to discuss strategy with your friends. In addition to voice chat, gamers will be able to experience individualized matchmaking, view player statistics, earn player achievements, customize their games, and build and personalize their gamer profiles over Xbox Live.

items.title: Gears of War
items.overview: This expanded version for Windows added a new story Act, as well as new multiplayer maps.

items.title: Gears of War 2: Flashback Map Pack
items.overview:
The Flashback Map Pack is the first downloadable content pack (DLC) for the 2008 game Gears of War 2. It came bundled with all new copies of Gears of War 2 at launch. It later became available for purchase for 400 Microsoft points. The third and final way to have it is to own the Gears of War Triple Pack (which includes the original Gears of War and Gears of War 2 + GoW2 DLC).

Flashback offers five tweaked multiplayer maps from the original Gears of War: Canals, Gridlock, Mansion, Subway, and Tyro Station; each of which was compatible with Horde mode.

items.title: Gears of War 2
items.overview: In Gears of War 2, The COG continues its fight against the Locust horde, who are attempting to sink all of the cities on the planet Sera by using a big riftworm to eat the ground beneath them. Sergeant Marcus Fenix leads Delta Squad into the depths of the planet to try to stop the worm from eating but instead they discover the true intent of the Locust actions.

items.title: Gears of War 2: Combustible Map Pack
items.overview: The Combustible Map Pack is the second downloadable content pack (DLC) for the 2008 game Gears of War 2. It includes three new fiery and explosive maps: Flood, Gold Rush, and Fuel Station.

items.title: Gears of War 2: Snowblind Map Pack
items.overview: The Snowblind Map Pack is the third downloadable content pack (DLC) for the 2008 game Gears of War 2. It includes four maps to play on, all with a winter-time theme. Two of these, Fuel Depot and Courtyard, are winterized remakes from previous Gears Of War maps. The other two, Underhill and Grind Yard, are completely new.

items.title: Gears of War 2: All Fronts Collection
items.overview: This content pack features all 19 downloadable Gears 2 multiplayer maps and a bonus deleted single-player chapter, "Road to Ruin," from the Gears of War 2 campaign. For multiplayer fans, this pack brings together the complete set of Gears 2 multiplayer maps: Allfathers Garden, Canals, Courtyard, Flood, Fuel Depot, Fuel Station, Gold Rush, Gridlock, Grind Yard, Highway, Mansion, Memorial, Nowhere, Sanctuary, Subway, Tyro Station, Under Hill, War Machine, and Way Station—everything in the Flashback, Combustible, Snowblind, and Dark Corners downloadable packs combined

items.title: Gears of War 2: Dark Corners
items.overview:
The Dark Corners Multiplayer Map Pack is the fourth and final downloadable content pack (DLC) for the 2008 game Gears of War 2. It includes:

- A bonus deleted single-player chapter, Road to Ruin, where players can choose between completing the scene guns blazing or stealthily
- Additional achievements for 325 gamerpoints
- Seven new multiplayer maps (War Machine, Allfathers Garden, Highway, Memorial, Nowhere, Way Station, and Sanctuary)

items.title: Gears of War: Triple Pack
items.overview: Gears of War Triple Pack contains the original Gears of War, Gears of War 2, and the Gears of War 2: All Fronts Collection, which includes the "Road to Ruin" campaign and 19 multiplayer maps.

items.title: Gears of War 3
items.overview: Gears of War 3 is the spectacular conclusion to one of the most memorable and celebrated sagas in videogames. Gears of War 3 plunges players into a harrowing tale of hope, survival and brotherhood. In Gears of War 3, players fight on as Marcus Fenix, the grizzled war hero and leader of Delta Squad. Eighteen months after the fall of the last human city, the war against the Locust rages on. Meanwhile, deep beneath the surface, a fearsome new threat is infecting the planet from within. With survivors scattered and civilization in ruins, time is running out for Marcus and his comrades as they fight to save the human race.

items.title: Gears of War 3: Raam's Shadow
items.overview: RAAM's Shadow is the second installment of downloadable content for Gears of War 3. The pack features a three-hour campaign set before the original Gears of War, following the exploits of Zeta Squad (Michael Barrick, Minh Young Kim, Tai Kaliso, and Alicia Valera), and also contains six multiplayer character skins, one weapon skin set (Chocolate) and additional achievements worth 250 Gamerscore.

items.title: Gears of War 3: Fenix Rising
items.overview:
Fenix Rising is the third installment of downloadable content for Gears of War 3.

Fenix Rising contains five multiplayer maps (Academy, Anvil, Depths, Escalation, and The Slab), four character skins (Recruit Clayton, Thrashball Cole, Savage Marauder, and Savage Kantus), three unlockable weapon skin sets (Re-Up Plasma, Re-Up Omen, and Re-Up Electric), and a new "Re-Up" system for multiplayer that allows players to rank up through level 100 multiple times to unlock exclusive emblems and weapon skins.

games.title: Crescent County
games.overview: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech open world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Decorate your flat, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

games.title: Silver Pines
games.overview: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.title: Ominous Recall
games.overview: Ominous Recall: A chilling survival horror game set in a photorealistic Middle East. Confront a terrifying Jinn possessing Stephen and unravel its dark power in this intense psychological thriller.

games.title: Danchi Days
games.overview:
Help Hoshino bring her hometown back together in a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in 2000s Japan! She'll face malevolent forces, uncover truths about her town, all while reconnecting with neighbors and her grandma living with dementia.

By gingham games - that's sandy powder, mogumu, and Melos Han-Tani (of Analgesic Productions)!

games.title: Fiefdom
games.overview: Change the world, one battle at a time in FIEFDOM: a multiplayer action melee game set in a playerbase-driven story. Clash swords, cast spells, rain down arrows & more in in battles of up to 100 players both at land & at sea. Dive into a world where your victories define the outcome of entire wars. Who will you be fighting for?

games.title: Am I Nima
games.overview: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.title: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
games.overview: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

games.title: Neverway
games.overview: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.

games.title: End of Abyss
games.overview: Play as the young combat technician, Cel, as she uncovers the truth behind the facility's derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that roam them.

games.title: DayZ: Badlands
games.overview: DayZ Badlands throws you into the troubled territories of Nasdara Province—267km² of arid expanse. Uncover its secrets, battle for control, forge fragile alliances and rebuild from the ashes of past wars. Survival here isn't just measured in drops of water saved, but in bullets spared.

games.title: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
games.overview: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

items.title: Nightbreed: The Action Game
items.overview:
This is the first of a planned trilogy of games based on Clive Barker's movie Nightbreed (the second game was Nightbreed: The Interactive Movie, and the third game was never released). This is a side-scrolling action game where Boone must fight his way through Midian, fighting the Sons of the Free and the Berserkers.

There are five legs to Boone's quest as listed in the manual

items.title: Nightbreed: The Interactive Movie
items.overview:
This is a mixture of action and adventure in a game based off of Clive Barker's movie "Nightbreed" (which is based of Barker's novella Cabal). You play Aaron Boone, the main character from both the book and the movie. Boone is attempting to get to a planet of bliss called Midian. His attempts at gaining acceptable go wrong when he is bitten by a cannibal, and the Police of Earth find Midian and set out to destroy it. Boone must stop them.

The game has several different sequences, most arcade based, trying to bring sequences from the movie to life on the computer screen. There are eight action types from driving to Midian, running from Peloquin the cannibal, or fighting 'The Mask', a serial killer whom Boone is mistaken for.

items.title: Clive Barker's Undying
items.overview: The masterful author who brought you the Hellraiser films and countless successful horror novels tries his hand at video games with this creepy, haunting saga. Set in the early 1920s, the action takes place in the Irish countryside and revolves around a plagued fellow by the name of Patrick Galloway. Full of terrifying twists and turns, the game follows Galloway as he's haunted by specters--an ailment that will slowly drive him to the brink of insanity over the course of the game's many chapters. He'll have both magic and some powerful weaponry to help him through his journey, but as the plot thickens, so does the level of difficulty. Blending fever-pitch action with a deep, thorough story, Clive Barker's Undying is chilly enough to keep you up at night and addicting enough to occupy you for weeks.

items.title: Clive Barker's Jericho
items.overview: Jericho is a horror-themed FPS from the mind of screen legend Clive Barker. In the game, a Jericho Team must fight through a lost city to destroy the evil at its heart.

games.title: Valor Mortis
games.overview: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

games.title: Steel Ark
games.overview: A first-person survival sandbox game where you explore a post-apocalyptic world, scavenge resources, craft production chains, and keep your train base running against all odds.

games.title: Bot.vinnik Chess Masters Academy
games.overview: Listen up, comrade! Tired of feeling like a terrible chess player? Ditch the flashy modern tools. My routine is simple: I teach you a sharp concept, you apply it in a puzzle, then I unveil the secret twist. Survive my training, and become a true chess master!

games.title: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered
games.overview: A striking modern revival of "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3" and "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends," which established the foundation of the entire series. The complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields will be beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5. Aim for the peak of 1 vs 1,000 action in this even more enjoyable and thrilling revival.

items.title: Dynasty Warriors
items.overview: Dynasty Warriors is a 3D fighting game steeped in traditional Chinese history and mythology, its characters being warriors from the Three Kingdoms era, a setting that was used by Koei before in their Romance of the Three Kingdoms series.

items.title: Dynasty Warriors 2
items.overview: An Age of Legends brought alive with the thrill and speed of action and the depth of simulation. The age of true battle is about to begin!

items.title: Dynasty Warriors 3
items.overview:
Dynasty Warriors 3 is the third installment of the Dynasty Warriors series in North America and the second within the Shin Sangoku Musou series in Japan. It is a spin-off from the video game Romance of the Three Kingdoms and based around a series of books by the same name, written by Luo Guanzhong.

The game contains a number of fictional and non-fictional elements from the same era in Chinese history that Romance of the Three Kingdoms is set. However, it follows the main events of part of the story which is to unify China under the single rule of a kingdom.

items.title: Dynasty Warriors 3: Xtreme Legends
items.overview:
Dynasty Warriors 3: Xtreme Legends is a stand-alone expansion to Dynasty Warriors 3. In both games, you take control of a military general in ancient China, each with their own unique abilities and weapons.

The gameplay is simple: you destroy hoards of differently ranked enemies on an open battlefield. Your objective in most missions is to defeat one or more enemy generals. Each character you choose has a different storyline (this story mode is referred to as "Musou Mode"), with seven battles progressing the story along. Battles get harder as you move along in the story. There is also a free mode, which allows you to play any level that you have unlocked with any general that you have unlocked (you start the game with three generals from three different dynasties).

The difference between Xtreme Legends and the original Dynasty Warriors 3 is that in Xtreme Legends, the Musou Mode only features seven unaligned generals that you couldn't play as outside of Free Mode. There are also challenge modes in Xtreme Legends not featured in the original. And there is a more advanced bodyguard system allowing you to name them, customize their advancement, and choose from more weapons you unlock as you play through the game.

items.title: Dynasty Warriors 4
items.overview:
Dynasty Warriors 4 is a hack and slash video game and the fourth installment in the popular Dynasty Warriors series. Dynasty Warriors 4 was developed by Omega Force and is based on a series of books called Romance of the Three Kingdoms, written by Luo Guanzhong. As the series has progressed, it has strayed further from the actual plot of Romance of the Three Kingdoms but instead has given the user more input on how the storyline progresses.

Originally released on the PS2 in March 2003, it was later ported to the Xbox in September of the same year and, in 2005, ported to the PC under the name Dynasty Warriors 4 Hyper.

items.title: Dynasty Warriors 4: Xtreme Legends
items.overview: Dynasty Warriors 4: Xtreme Legends includes all 42 characters from the original Dynasty Warriors 4, with new gameplay elements. Engage in randomly generated skirmishes in Xtreme Mode. Live the exploits of all warriors in Legends Mode. Experience endurance-style duels in the Arena Challenge. Play it by itself or in conjunction with the original using Xtreme Legends' disc swap feature. Here's your chance to become a legend among legends.

items.title: Dynasty Warriors 4: Empires
items.overview: Dynasty Warriors 4: Empires is a strategy-oriented variant of Dynasty Warriors 4, mixing it with gameplay similar to Romance of the Three Kingdoms. The heart of the game, campaign mode, begins by choosing any of 24 regions and 42 rulers (custom characters can be created). Beginning with a small kingdom, the ultimate goal is the conquering of all others. Each turn, the player is given a choice from 4 different governing options (brought to your attention by your generals) followed by a single decision of action. These actions typically include the invasion or defense of a specific province or the option to aid an allied empire with those same actions.

items.title: Dynasty Warriors
items.overview:
A portable version of Dynasty Warriors released for the PSP in 2004 in Japan and in 2005 in North America and Europe, being one of the launch titles for this console in both North America and Japan.

It adds new modes to the Dynasty Warrior franchise. Unlike previous games, it allows the player to have up to four deployable officers to accompany them during battle. These officers range from characters who are otherwise playable to generic officers with unique skills and traits.

items.title: Dynasty Warriors 5
items.overview: Dynasty Warriors 5 is a hack and slash video game set in China and the fifth installment in the Dynasty Warriors series, developed by Omega Force and published by Koei. The game was released on the PlayStation 2 and Xbox. It is based on the Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms by Luo Guanzhong.

items.title: Dynasty Warriors Advance
items.overview: Your kingdom is under attack! Powerful rivals surround you, waiting for the chance to strike, and only you have the power to save the day. With nowhere to hide, you unleash an awesome Musou attack and watch your enemies fall! Savor the victory, because even greater challenges lie before you!

items.title: Dynasty Warriors 4: Hyper
items.overview:
Dynasty Warriors 4 is a hack and slash video game and the fourth installment in the popular Dynasty Warriors series. Dynasty Warriors 4 Hyper was developed by Omega Force and is based on a series of books called Romance of the Three Kingdoms, written by Luo Guanzhong. As the series has progressed, it has strayed further from the actual plot of Romance of the Three Kingdoms but instead has given the user more input on how the storyline progresses.

Dynasty Warriors 4 was ported to the PC under the name Dynasty Warriors 4 Hyper.

items.title: Dynasty Warriors 5: Xtreme Legends
items.overview:
Dynasty Warriors 5: Xtreme Legends is a standalone expansion to Dynasty Warriors 5.

It brings back Xtreme Mode and Legend Mode from Dynasty Warriors 4: Xtreme Legends while introducing Destiny Mode where players can fight under one of the three kingdoms as an edit officer.

games.title: The False Alice: Retold Tale
games.overview: A visual novel based on the Itsuwari no Alice gacha game. It will features a new scenario and new CGs, backgrounds, BGM, character facial expressions and pose differences.

games.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Avatar Legends Pack
Corinne
games.overview: Navigate Corinne through a realm of pixel horrors, surrounded by neighbors that are turning into bloodthirsty monsters. Discover the secrets of this twisted dimension before it's too late for Corinne and her friends.

games.title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
games.overview: Soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.

items.title: Air Combat
items.overview:
The first game of the Ace Combat series.

Combat flight simulator in which you play a mercenary pilot who hires his combat skills to several corporations, governments, etc. in order to get cash for weapons & upgrades.

The game progresses through a series of linear missions, and has a 2 player split-screen deathmatch mode plus a series of extras like hidden planes, mini-games, etc.

items.title: Ace Combat 2
items.overview:
Ace Combat 2 serves as the follow-up to Namco's Air Combat, a combat flight simulator for the PlayStation. In this sequel, the player steps into the shoes of a mercenary pilot, determined to thwart a global terrorist conspiracy. With 30 challenging missions ahead, your triumphs will enable you to acquire weapon upgrades, parts, and various enhancements, mirroring the mechanics of the original game.

Enhanced with crisper visuals and more immersive audio, Ace Combat 2 also boasts an expanded array of planes and customisable options. Additionally, it introduces dual shock support, along with the inclusion of analogue joystick support, enriching the overall gaming experience.

items.title: Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere
items.overview:
Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere is a combat flight simulation video game developed and published by Namco for the PlayStation. The third game in the Ace Combat franchise, it was released in Japan in 1999.

Players control an aircraft and must complete various mission objectives, such as destroying squadrons of enemies or protecting a base from enemy fire. Electrosphere carries a more futuristic science fiction-inspired landscape and world compared to the modern-day theme of its predecessors.

The japanese version of Ace Combat 3 differs significantly from the international release: its campaign features 52 missions split among different paths depending on in-mission decisions. The story centers around the "Intercorporate War" in 2040 between Neucom Incorporated and the General Group.

items.title: Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere
items.overview:
Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere is a combat flight simulation video game developed by Namco for the PlayStation. The third game in the Ace Combat franchise, it was released in Europe and North America in 2000 and was localized for specific regions.

Players control an aircraft and must complete various mission objectives, such as destroying squadrons of enemies or protecting a base from enemy fire. Electrosphere carries a more futuristic science fiction-inspired landscape and world compared to the modern-day theme of its predecessors.

The international version of Ace Combat 3 differs significantly from the japanese release: its campaign has 36 out of the original 52 missions with no different paths. The story, as well as all related voice acting and cutscenes, was removed and replaced with a more basic story with no voice acting.

items.title: Ace Combat 04: Shattered Skies
items.overview: Ace Combat 04: Shattered Skies is an aerial combat simulation. It allows the player to participate in semi-realistic dog-fighting with a collection of fighter jets, including the F-22 Raptor, F-16 Fighting Falcon, F-117 Nighthawk, U-2 Dragon Lady, C-130 Hercules and SR-71 Blackbird. Eighteen missions will take the player from search-and-destroy buildings to one-on-one and all-on-all dog-fighting. Along the way it becomes possible to upgrade the fighter with defense systems, deadly weapons, and other accessories.

items.title: Ace Combat 5: The Unsung War
items.overview: Ace Combat 5: The Unsung War is a first person air combat and flight simulator. Like other Ace Combat games, each mission is determined by a level briefing and objectives. There are 32 missions in the main campaign mode, while an additional "arcade" mode puts the player in the role of Mobius One (from Ace Combat 04: Shattered Skies) as he faces endless waves of enemy attacks. Regardless of the mode chosen, once in the air the player will have control over speed, direction, altitude, gun cannon, missiles and special weapon of their aircraft. A new feature from previous Ace Combat games, is the concept of Wingmen and being able to issue simple orders to them in the air. This allows the player to better coordinated group attacks as well as giving each wingman a personality of their own. Additionally, the player as squadron leader will be asked to make decisions ("Yes/No") while flying in the air. Between missions, the story is progressed through a series of cutscenes.

items.title: Ace Combat Advance
items.overview: The Ace Combat series makes its debut on the Game Boy Advance with challenging missions, unlockable planes, and free-roaming environments. As the newest pilot in an elite fighter squadron, you must help destroy the Air Strike Force--the military arm of an evil multinational corporation. If you destroy enough enemy planes during your missions, you'll unlock new planes. Fly in air-to-air and air-to-ground missions over arctic, forest, and desert environments. Each environment features destructible buildings and objects.

items.title: Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War
items.overview: The sixth installment in the Ace Combat series explores the Belkan War, a devastating conflict alluded to in Ace Combat 5. In the game's main story mode, the player takes control of a mercenary pilot, callsign "Cipher", taking part in the Belkan War by advancing through aerial combat, escort, assault, and defense missions. The story is told through the eyes of a reporter, 10 years after the conflict, uncovering secrets of the war by interviewing some of the pilots the player shoots down.

items.title: Ace Combat X: Skies of Deception
items.overview: The first PSP entry of the series and a new game in the franchise, Ace Combat X: Skies of Deception promises everything you'd expect of Namco's flight simulation series, including detailed jet models, an original storyline told through CG, options for fine tuning your machines, and plenty of real world jets. In Campaign Mode, you play as a pilot in the Gryphus Squadron of the Federal Republic of Aurelia. Defending the invaded country, your mission will take you to the battle-filled skies in order to take down the enemy and restore freedom and peace to their homeland. Campaign mode makes use of the Strategic AI System, where the contents of a mission change based on the strategies that you select. The game also has a multiplayer mode for up to four players. In addition to a last-man standing dog fight mode, you'll be able to split into teams for cooperative combat.

items.title: Ace Combat 6: Fires of Liberation
items.overview:
Throughout Ace Combat 6, the player must pilot a fighter jet or other aircraft to destroy foes both in the air and on the ground. As an arcade flight game, it simplifies flight controls and gives the player a large amount of bullets, missiles and other weapons, putting them up against a very large amount of enemy forces. In addition to missiles and a vulcan cannon, the player can equip special weapons such as heat-seeking missiles, bombs, rocket launchers, and others. The player can lock on to a number of foes, and assist different tactical squads by switching between their respective HUD readouts.

The game includes 4 default multiplayer modes: Battle Royale, Siege Battle, Team Battle, and Co-Op Battle. In Battle Royale, the basic Deathmatch game mode, up to sixteen players shoot each other down to earn the highest points at the time limit. In Team Battle, a basic Team Deathmatch game is created. Points are awarded based on the type of aircraft destroyed. A unique type of multiplayer game, Siege Battle is played with two teams, Attacking and Defending. The Attacking team attempts to destroy the target (usually heavily defended by flak) within the time limit. The Defending team tries to halt their attack. The co-op battle mode consists of two single-player missions without AI that can be played with up to three other players.

items.title: Ace Combat Xi: Skies of Incursion
items.overview: Ace Combat Xi: Skies of Incursion was the first and only Ace Combat game released on the Apple App Store for iOS Devices. It is set before the events of Ace Combat X: Skies of Deception, covering the first 10 days of the Aurelian-Leasath War.

items.title: Ace Combat: Joint Assault
items.overview: Joint Assault retains the basic gameplay from its predecessor, but with significant additions and alterations. Aerial combat adopts a visual system called "Enhanced Combat View" to alter the perspective of enemy aircraft close to the player, altering their size to make them appear much closer as a precursor to Dogfight Mode from Ace Combat: Assault Horizon.

games.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
games.overview: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer is a runs-based, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

games.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.overview: 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows. Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

items.title: Castlevania
items.overview:
Step into the shadows of the deadliest dwelling on earth. You've arrived at Castlevania, and you're here on business: To destroy forever the Curse of the Evil Count.

Unfortunately, everybody's home this evening. Bats, ghosts, every kind of creature you can imagine. You'll find 'em all over the place, if they don't find you first. Because you've got to get through six monstrous floors before you even meet up with the Master of the House. Your Magic Whip will help, and you'll probably find a weapons or two along the way. But once you make it to the tower, you can count on a Duel to the Death. The Count has waited 100 years for a rematch.

items.title: Vampire Killer
items.overview:
Vampire Killer is a side-view flick-screen game where you are a Vampire hunter who has been tasked to remove Dracula from the 12th floor of a block of flats by a client on the floor below. The problem is, as well as facing and killing a vampire, the job has to be completed before midnight which is only eight minutes away. In your rush to get to the building you have forgotten your equipment like garlic and stakes, which is needed to face Dracula. You have to get to the 12th floor using elevators (which have minds of their own and can take you down as well as up), and you must look behind the doors of each flat for equipment to help you.

Some flats are also empty as well as flats that have scares inside you and when scared, you lose part of a shock meter and when it reaches zero then it is game over. Bats and spiders live on various floors with some blocking your route so bullets can be found in the flats to clear the way. Some doors to the flats actually are lift shafts which send you back down to the 1st floor. Before you play the game you can select your skill level from easy, medium and hard.

items.title: Vs. Castlevania
items.overview: You play Simon who must battle his way through the castle using his trusty whip. The object is to fight off the evil enemies on your way to find the Count, and if you're lucky, destroy him.

items.title: Castlevania II: Simon's Quest
items.overview: Castlevania was a cakewalk compared to this bloody curse. You thought you had the Prince of Darkness defanged - eh, Simon Belmont? Well think again, 'cause according to a damsel in distress, evil Count Dracula has left a horrifying curse in his wake. And the only hope you have of ending the terror is to destroy his missing body parts! Talk about your frightening quest, searching a maze of mansions, graveyards and dark, eerie forests - each guarded by man-eating werewolves, fire-throwing zombies and other devilish demons. Your grim chances are kept alive in Transylvania, where cowardly villagers offer clues to the whereabouts of Dracula's remains. And where you'll purchase magic weapons, including silver knives and flame whips. But beware the night. For when the sun disappears, Dracula's curse grows deadlier. And your chances grow dimmer and dimmer.

items.title: Haunted Castle
items.overview:
Count Dracula sleeps for a long hundred of years. During this time, peace exists at the village and Dracula is nothing but a mere legend.

However, one day a young couple named Simon and Serena were celebrating their wedding at the village's church.

The couple were enveloped with happiness, as the wedding bells rang, their future seemed blessed...

Suddenly, the empty sky was covered with dark clouds and with a rolling thunder that shook the earth, Dracula has once again awakened. Asking for the beautiful girl's blood, he flew down during the middle of the wedding and suddenly took the bride with him.

Now in order to save Serena, Simon heads to the demon castle

items.title: Castlevania: The Adventure
items.overview:
Castlevania: The Adventure is a platform game released for the Game Boy in 1989. It is the first Castlevania title for the system.

Set a century before the events of the original Castlevania, the player controls an ancestor of Simon Belmont named Christopher Belmont who goes on a quest to defeat Dracula.

items.title: Akumajou Densetsu
items.overview: Akumajou Densetsu is the Japanese version of Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse. This version has many differences in gameplay and level layout, making the overall experience easier than its western counterpart.

items.title: Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse
items.overview: Led by the immortal Count Dracula, the greatest army of evil ever assembled is poised to bury mankind in a Tomb of Terror. Destroying this legion of Swamp Dragons, Slasher Skeletons and Forces of the Undead will be the supreme challenge for the mightiest of warriors. Your place in history is 100 years before Simon Belmont's birth. Dracula is young at heart, and it will take more than a stake to penetrate his evil. Luckily, you command the role of Trevor - Simon's forefather and the origin of the Belmont Warlord Chromosomes. Trevor has a power never before seen by human eyes - the power to transform into three different spirits: Grant DaNasty, the ferocious Ghost Pirate. Sypha, the Mystic Warlord. And Alucard, Dracula's forgotten son. You must perfectly time Trevor's body transformations to match up his different fighting spirits against Ultimate Evils. Trevor also has the strength and wisdom to command the Battle Axe, Invisibility Potion and Mystic Whip. But the most important weapon Trevor has is your cunning to choose the correct Paths of Fate and your bravery to lead him past 17 possible levels of never-ending doom, including the Haunted Ship of Fools, the Sunken City of Poltergeists, the Clock Tower of Untimely Death and Curse Castle. Never before have so many dangers confronted you at one time. And if by some miracle you triumph, you'll no longer be a mere mortal. You'll be a legend who'll live forever!

items.title: Kid Dracula
items.overview:
Kid Dracula is a platformer video game made by Konami. It was released only in Japan for the Famicom on 19 October 1990. It is considered a parody of the Castlevania series. A version for mobile phones was also released on 30 June 2006 in Japan only.

The game saw ports for the PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and Microsoft Windows as part of the Castlevania Anniversary Collection which was released digitally on May 16, 2019 in all regions.

games.title: Bravery
games.overview: BRAVERY is a third-person 3D adventure game in which players guide a fragile matchstick character through vast, detailed environments that appear enormous in scale. Gameplay focuses on exploration, tense chase sequences, and interactive fire mechanics that allow objects to be ignited. Throughout the journey, players discover hidden areas and capture enigmatic orbs that are sealed within restored magical mirrors, shaping progression through the world.

games.title: Spline: Part One
games.overview: A narrative-driven psychological horror game in which a man searching for his missing wife becomes trapped within a distorted reality known as the Spline, navigating hostile environments, persistent threats, and fragmented clues that reveal the nature of the world around him.

games.title: The Legend of Chalkvania
